resources.string: Export the history to a ZIP file in a folder you choose, or import one back. Imports merge without duplicating messages. The file is not encrypted: keep it somewhere safe.
Import finished: %1$d new messages, %2$d already present.
This file is not a backup of this app or comes from a newer version.
The operation failed. Check the file and try again.

Notifications only carry a preview of photos. To keep the actual files, choose a folder where your messenger saves received media (for example a WhatsApp media folder inside Android/media, or a folder you export media to). The app copies files whose time matches a message with a photo. Android may block some app folders in the folder picker; in that case, save the media to an accessible folder and choose that one.
Folder chosen. New matching files are copied when you scan.
